task_requests.description: Analyze VaR trend data for the Flagship Long/Short fund risk exposure monitor and report findings.
Perform stress testing analysis on the risk exposure data and report findings.

args.data: Coordinator Note: Two workstreams have been delegated to support the risk build. The var-analyst workstream is tasked with analyzing VaR trend data for the Flagship Long/Short fund risk exposure monitor and reporting findings. The stress-analyst workstream is tasked with performing stress testing analysis on the risk exposure data and reporting findings. The VaR Trend widget (risk_exposure_monitor_dashboard_var_trend) has been added to the dashboard to supply the var-analyst workstream with data (fund: Flagship Long/Short, period: YTD).
